text: Solverde, S.A.'s 2025 annual report states that its share capital is 6,000,000 shares and that its parent company, Violas - Empresa Gestora de Participações Sociais, S.A., holds 5,619,964 of them, 93.67% of the capital; the other 380,036 (6.33%) are the company's own shares. The report's related-parties note says Solverde is 93.67% held by Violas, S.G.P.S., S.A., based in Espinho.
short: Solverde is 93.67% held by Violas SGPS; the other 6.33% are its own shares.
